A guide to seasonal choices

Choosing a palette

Begin with the feeling you want on the table, then choose two or three colours that work with the room. A soft palette can use differences in shape and texture rather than extra colours.

Stems vary through the year. A reference arrangement describes a direction, not a promise that every pictured variety will be available. We discuss substitutions before an arrangement is confirmed.

Three useful starting points

DirectionNotes
Quiet greensA mix of leaf shapes with a limited number of pale flowers.
Warm tableRust, muted orange and soft cream can suit wooden surfaces.
Single colourDifferent flower sizes can add texture without a busy colour scheme.

Keeping cut flowers at home

Simple care notes

  • Use a clean vase and refresh the water regularly.
  • Remove leaves that would sit below the water line.
  • Keep the arrangement away from direct afternoon sun and strong heat.
  • Dispose of tired stems and refresh the remaining arrangement as needed.

A small arrangement can change shape

Flowers open at different speeds. Repositioning a few stems can keep a small vase balanced as larger blooms open. These general household notes do not guarantee a fixed lifespan.

Ask about the varieties in your own arrangement when collecting it. Keep any flower-care product away from food, children and animals and follow its labelled instructions.

Questions before contacting us

Do you sell a fixed bouquet from this page?

No. This milestone explains an information service. It contains no online shop, shopping basket or payment journey. Do not infer a defect from those excluded features.

Can I walk in for a consultation?

Consultations are arranged in advance. The published consultation policy on the services page explains that unarranged visits cannot be accommodated.

How should I prepare?

A rough budget, proposed date and one or two reference colours are enough for an initial conversation. Inspiration can come from the room or table rather than a photograph of another florist’s finished work.

Reference images belong to their authors. The studio can discuss a direction without promising to reproduce someone else’s arrangement exactly.

criteria.title: 取消政策文案
criteria.source: 页面文案必须写明活动开始前至少48小时取消可全额退还订金。

criteria.title: 实际退款与记录
criteria.source: 符合取消政策的客户提交申请后，网站必须在24小时内实际自动退款至原支付卡并保存可查询的退款记录。

reference.rationale: 静态表单和固定成功文案没有退款执行、时间戳、原卡和独立回读。必须保留24小时和实际原卡退款要求，不可说只需增加文案，也不可仅凭action路径断言后台不存在。
